task.instruction: Search for the latest research papers on quantum computing submitted to ArXiv within the last two days.

final_answer:
I searched arXiv's advanced search for "quantum computing" (all fields, cross-lists included) filtered to submission dates 5–7 November 2026. The search returned 44 hits, but most are revised versions of older papers (v1 dates back to 2024–2026). Only **19 are genuinely new submissions**, all submitted 5 November 2026 — a separate query restricted to 6–7 November 2026 returned no results at all, so arXiv had not yet posted anything dated 6–7 November at the time of the search.

**New quantum computing papers (submitted 5 Nov 2026)**

1. **Quantum Knowledge Distillation: State-of-the-art, Applications and Open Problems** — Al-Sulaiti, Chen, Dastagir, Farouk, Al-Kuwari (quant-ph, 2611.08461). Survey of distillation in quantum machine learning; finds gains are task- and architecture-dependent, with hardware evaluations still limited.
2. **Polynomial-time classical simulation of boson and fermion sampling under thermal loss** — Angrisani, Mhiri (quant-ph/cs.CC/math-ph/physics.optics, 2611.08444). Shows noisy sampling experiments lose their advantage: polynomial-time classical simulation for any fixed nonzero loss rate.
3. **Deep-learning surrogate model for rapid quantum-noise computation in dual-pump fiber-optic phase-sensitive amplifiers** — Bouasria et al. (physics.optics, 2611.08437). ~400× speedup in noise-figure prediction with 0.0015 dB MAE.
4. **QDiff: Differential Testing of Quantum Software Stacks** — Wang, Zhang, Xu, Kim (quant-ph/cs.SE, 2611.08220). Semantics-preserving program transformation plus equivalence checking for testing quantum compilers and simulators.
5. **Zirah: A Post-Quantum True Random Number Generator Hardware Signer With an Avalanche Noise** — M. S. B. Junaid (cs.CR/cs.AR, 2611.08200). ML-DSA-65 signer on an STM32F407 with avalanche-noise entropy; documents a key-extraction failure on an earlier board.
6. **Quantum Advantage with Sign-Free Proofs: An Oracle Separation between StoqMA and MA** — Hamoudi, Le Borgne, Sridhara (quant-ph/cs.CC/cs.DS, 2611.08180). Proves MA ⊊ StoqMA relative to a classical oracle — a minimal quantum resource already beats classical verifiers.
7. **Non-Unitary Quantum Butterfly Effect: Theory and Experiment** — Argyle, Lakhdar-Hamina, Miller, Galitski (quant-ph/cond-mat.other, 2611.08152). Generalizes the OTOC to non-unitary systems and verifies it on Quantinuum's trapped-ion hardware.
8. **Machine learning quantum data to accelerate quantum Monte Carlo** — Jiang, Zhao, Kumar, Nigam, Rosenberg, Babbush, Baczewski, Huggins, Lee (quant-ph/physics.chem-ph, 2611.08151).
9. **Accelerating Quantum-Classical Auxiliary-Field Quantum Monte Carlo with Shadow-Trained Neural Quantum States** — Provazza et al. (quant-ph, 2611.08129).
10. **Post-Quantum Authentication of IoT Data on Ethereum: Signatures, the Calldata Floor, and Device-Signed Merkle Roots** — Ming-Fong Sie (cs.DC, 2611.08108).
11. **Semi-Analytical Geometric Synthesis of Robust Quantum Controls** — Lussi, de Santiago, Duzzioni, Silveira (quant-ph, 2611.08107).
12. **Quantum Advantage in Local Certification of Graph Properties** — Jáuregui, Miyamoto (cs.DC, 2611.08076).
13. **Exponential mixing time for the Davies dynamics of the quantum random energy model** — De Palma, Mingione (quant-ph, 2611.08064).
14. **Autler-Townes energy-level engineering for high-quality all-microwave qubit gate** — Gao, He, Niu, Li, Bao, Liu, You, Tsai, Wang, Lin (quant-ph, 2611.07967).
15. **Monopoles, Scattering and Generalized Symmetries on a Quantum Computer** — O'Brien, Ueda, Granet, Dreyer, Verstraete (quant-ph, 2611.07960).
16. **Multirobust Control Pulses Designed by Iterative Quantum Kolmogorov-Arnold-Moser Algorithm** — Harutyunyan, Guérin (quant-ph, 2611.07802).
17. **Exact and Near-Exact Inverse Renormalization Group with Constrained Monte Carlo** — Dimitrios Bachtis (hep-lat, 2611.07641).
18. **Quantum action for heterotic string field theory with quantum L-infinity structure** — Gen, Kunitomo, Totsuka (hep-th, 2611.07635).
19. **eigenkit: A Provider-Neutral Quantum Computing Library** — Domingo, Tarpanov, Senokosov, Sagingalieva (quant-ph, 2611.02979).

**Notable among the revised (v1) papers:** "On the geometry, typicality, and detectability of quantum magic" (Liu & Liu), "BRIDGE: Lazy-Move Compilation for Dual-Species Neutral-Atom Quantum Computers," "High-performance cellular automaton decoders for quantum repetition and toric code," "Quantum Channel Polynomial Processing," and "CLAIMSTAB-QC for Auditing Comparative Claims in Quantum Software."

If you want, I can pull full abstracts for any of these, or narrow the search to a specific subfield (e.g. quant-ph only, or hardware vs. algorithms).

judge.rationale: The agent used arXiv advanced search with “quantum computing” and submission-date filters for Nov 5–7, then reported the resulting papers and confirmed no Nov 6–7 results.
